data_source: Zenodo dataset supplied by the user: Deliver_data/*_fill_Corrected_with_metrics.csv (Ultra Sound Garbage Bin Sensor Reading Records; source files identify container fill readings)
target: Hours from each reading until the first later fill reading at or above 80%, within the same Cidx collection cycle
weight: No measured weight column is supplied in the selected fill CSV files. Weight is not used by this model; do not convert fill percentage to kg without verified container capacity.

split.method: Chronological split by cycle start; entire collection cycles are assigned to one split to prevent a cycle crossing train/test boundaries.

training_notes: Only corrected fill CSV files were used; rec/collection-event CSV files were not used as predictor features.
Rows with missing Cidx, Date or Fill were excluded.
A target was generated only for readings with a later >=80% reading in the same Cidx cycle.
Feature values use only the current reading, cycle start time, and timestamp-derived calendar values.
The 80% collection threshold is an operational modelling choice, not a validated physical safety threshold.
Test performance is weak; this linear model is a prototype and should not be presented as a reliable operational forecast.
